notes:
August 15th 2026
Version 13.3+ (stable) / 13.4+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Expansion pack summary shows which packs are needed or not used. (R)
* Now auto converts 4x/8x Upg's between automatically. (R)
* Added feature to convert/fix non-playable AUDIO files[wav,mp3]. (R,K)
* Rearrange registers: drag to reorder Registers in any scene section. (K)
* Right click added copy special... paste special... (K)
* Revised/Updated the K-Configurator Users Manual. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
notes_beta:
August 22nd 2026
Version 13.3+ (stable) / 13.4+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Live Editor auto-loads when you stop changing the number. (R)
* Scene names can now be 28 characters. (K)
* Drag files onto the bug report box to attach them. (K,R)
* iPhone photos and scene files can now be attached. (K,R)
* Plus many smaller accuracy and reliability fixes throughout. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
